property_summary: For any owner-initiated call sendTo(receiver, amount), exactly `amount` wei is transferred to the `receiver` parameter (not to msg.sender/owner); the mutant sends the funds back to the owner, leaving the receiver's balance unchanged, so asserting the receiver's balance increases by `amount` holds on P for all inputs and fails on M whenever receiver != owner.
change_summary: Replace the transfer receiver with msg.sender instead of the receiver parameter.
